sso.title: Enterprise SSO
sso.description: SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM 2.0 automatic provisioning. Works as soon as you connect your enterprise IdP settings; if left unconfigured, it stays off and existing logins are unaffected.
sso.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage Enterprise SSO settings
sso.samlEnableHint: Once enabled, existing agents can log in through your enterprise IdP (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin, etc.). Only existing emails are matched; accounts aren't created automatically (unless SCIM provisioning is set up).
sso.idpCert: IdP signing certificate (X.509, PEM or base64)
sso.idpCertHint: Used to verify the signature of SAML assertions returned by the IdP. This is a public certificate (not a private key).
sso.structuralWarn: Currently in “structural validation” mode (parsing + certificate pinning + expiry checks); full XML-DSig cryptographic signature verification is not yet performed. Before going live, install the python3-saml / signxml dependencies on the backend to enable full signature verification.
sso.spDesc: Enter the following details in your IdP application settings.
sso.scimEnableHint: Once enabled, your IdP can automatically create, deactivate, and remove agent accounts via SCIM—no manual invitations needed.
sso.defaultRoleHint: Agents created via SCIM or logging in via SAML for the first time are assigned this role (must be an existing role in the tenant; default is agent).
sso.scimTokenSet: Token set; regenerating immediately invalidates the old token.
sso.scimTokenWarn: Save this token now and paste it into your IdP; it won't be shown again after you leave this page.
